_note: Hand-written Indian-style job posts, never used for training. Written to differ from the templates in augment_india.py (different structure, wording and tricks), including hard cases: scams without fees, genuine posts that mention WhatsApp or 'urgent'.

posts.text: Hiring for Flipkart warehouse packing job, salary 22000 + PF. Interested candidates pay 1200 rupees uniform and ID card charge through Google Pay to our HR before joining. Contact Priya ma'am 9847XXXX21.

Dear candidate, congratulations! You are shortlisted for the post of Assistant Manager at Tata Consultancy. Your offer letter is ready. Kindly transfer the refundable laptop security amount of Rs 6500 to the account given below within 24 hours to confirm.

Part time job for everyone. Rate restaurants on Google Maps and earn 150 per review. Daily withdrawal. Join our Telegram channel and complete 3 free tasks first, then upgrade to VIP level for bigger commission.
Work from home opportunity. Watch YouTube videos and like them. 50 rupees per like, up to 5000 per day. No investment for first task. Text 'START' on WhatsApp to begin.

Urgent vacancy in Qatar for helpers, drivers, cleaners. Free food and stay, salary 1800 riyal. Visa and medical charges 45,000 to be paid to our agent. Passport copy needed for processing. Interview on WhatsApp video call.
Indian Railways recruitment 2026 through our office. 100% placement guarantee for Group D posts without exam. Contact our coordinator, documents fee 3500 only.
Earn by investing in our crypto trading tasks. Deposit USDT and get 30 percent returns every week. Work from mobile. Our team will guide you on Telegram.

We need data entry staff urgently. You will receive PDF files and have to type them in Word. Payment 18000 per month. Sign the agreement and pay the 2499 processing charge to receive the first project.

Bank job openings for 12th pass and graduates. Back office and loan department. Salary 25 to 35k. Send your Aadhaar front and back, PAN card and your current account statement to our recruitment WhatsApp number for verification.

Hi, I am from the HR team of a reputed MNC. We saw your profile on Naukri. This is a simple online job, you just need to share our product links. To receive salary we need your UPI id and the code you will get by SMS.
Airport ground staff jobs in Kochi, Bengaluru and Delhi. Freshers can apply. Salary 28,000. Selection without interview. Registration amount 1999 rupees, paid via the link we send.
Students and homemakers can earn 1000 to 3000 daily by forwarding messages. No skill needed. To activate your account first pay a small amount of 299 which will be refunded with your first payout.
Amazon is hiring work from home customer support agents. Monthly 32000. Interview not required. Message our hiring manager on Telegram with your full name, date of birth and bank name.

Job offer: Content moderator, work from home, 20 hours per week. Selected candidates must purchase the company training kit worth Rs 4,750 before the onboarding call. Email jobs.contentdesk@gmail.com.

We are hiring Junior Web Developers at our Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram office. Requirements: knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and one backend language. Freshers with good projects are encouraged to apply. Apply on our website; shortlisted candidates will get a coding test link by email.

Urgent hiring: Staff Nurses for our 200-bed multispeciality hospital in Kozhikode. Requirements: B.Sc or GNM, Kerala Nursing Council registration, 1 year experience. Salary as per norms, accommodation available. Walk-in interview on Saturday at the hospital HR department, 10 am.

Accounts Assistant needed for a CA firm in Pune. B.Com graduate with knowledge of Tally Prime and GST returns. 0 to 2 years experience. Salary 18,000 to 24,000. Send your CV to the email on our website. Interview at our office.

Sales Officer, two-wheeler loans, for a leading NBFC in Coimbatore. Graduates with 1 year of field sales experience. Fixed salary plus incentives, PF, ESI and travel allowance. Apply through our careers page. For interview schedules, HR will contact you on WhatsApp.

Mathematics teacher for CBSE school in Mangaluru, classes 8 to 10. M.Sc with B.Ed required. Demo class and interview with the principal. Salary based on experience. Send resume to the school office email. We do not charge any fee from candidates.

Graduate Engineer Trainee (Mechanical) for our manufacturing plant in Hosur. B.E. Mechanical 2025/2026 pass-outs. One year training with stipend, then confirmation. Selection: written test, technical interview, medical check. Register on our careers portal to apply.

Customer Care Executive for a telecom company's Hyderabad centre. English and Telugu required, Hindi is a plus. Rotational shifts, 6 days a week. Salary 2.4 LPA plus night shift allowance and cab facility. Apply on Naukri or LinkedIn.

We are looking for a Data Analyst with 2+ years of experience in SQL, Python and Power BI to join our analytics team in Bengaluru. Hybrid working, health insurance for family, 24 days paid leave. Apply via LinkedIn. Interviews are conducted over video call.

HR Executive for a logistics company in Chennai. MBA HR with 2 years of experience in recruitment and payroll. Salary 30,000 to 38,000 per month. Interested candidates can email their resume. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview.

Hiring Electricians and Plumbers for our facility management team in Gurugram. ITI certificate and 2 years of experience required. Salary 16,000 to 20,000 plus overtime, ESI and PF. Walk in with your documents to our office, Monday to Saturday.

Internship: Digital Marketing intern (3 months) at a startup in Kochi. Learn SEO, social media and Google Ads. Stipend 8,000 per month, certificate on completion, chance of full-time offer. Apply with a short note about yourself through our internship form.

Pharmacist required for a retail pharmacy chain in Kolkata. D.Pharm or B.Pharm with a valid State Pharmacy Council registration. Salary 20,000 to 26,000. Day shift. Visit any of our branches with your resume or apply on our website.

Senior Java Developer, 5 to 8 years, product company in Noida. Strong Spring Boot, microservices, Kafka and AWS. CTC up to 28 LPA. Three interview rounds. Please apply through our careers site; our recruiters will never ask you for payment.

Office Administrator for an architecture firm in Ahmedabad. Manage office supplies, vendor payments, travel bookings and front desk. Graduate with 2 years of experience and good English and Gujarati. Salary 22,000 per month. Email your CV to apply.
